estimand: mean of five per-seed metrics conditional on fitted models and observed test partitions; MAE skill is mean per-seed 1-model_MAE/training_median_MAE
resampling: weights shared by union compound/group identifier across every model and regime within endpoint; classification compound weights class-stratified; regression compound and all fixed-group weights unstratified
binary_degeneracy: AUROC requires both classes; AUPRC requires positives and equals 1 for positive-only draws; empty/absent-class counts retained
intervals: percentile 2.5/97.5, complete finite five-seed means; all frontier-minus-scaffold and within-regime model pairs exploratory and unadjusted; no p-values
regression_units: original endpoint units kept separate; no cross-endpoint average
cyclic_subset: BBB and DILI only; exclude test rows in fixed grouping IDs starting __ACYCLIC; preserve complete original training sets and medians; bootstrap each subset union separately
gnn_mapping: included descriptor/scaffold only after every test/val row ID, SMILES and label matches canonical data and manifests
